name: Shion Kusakabe
source:
Shion is one of the project's more softspoken members. Naive and trusting to a fault, she has an unfortunate habit of getting into strange or even potentially dangerous situations. She has no aversion to human contact or technology, and no bone to pick with anyone, but still finds it hard to get close to others.

Always on the sidelines but quietly optimistic, Shion takes any chance she can to overturn her stagnant life and to find her own happiness. It is this dedication and hope that leads her to join the ranks of the Human Reignition Project.
